adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `_hydrateEmbedded` in `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6` to match `/(.+)_id(s?)$/` and, for any key ending in `*_ids`, it unconditionally runs `obj[k].map(...)`, assigns `obj[pluralize(subType)] = hydrated`, and deletes the original `*_ids` key. This is a broad behavior/contract change: any REST payload that previously had a plain attribute ending with `_ids` (or had `_ids` present but not as an array) would now be treated as an embedded has-many and could either throw (if non-array) or silently replace/delete the attribute and populate an array containing missing lookups (possibly `undefined`). The diff itself does not prove such payloads exist in production, but the concern is concrete and directly grounded in the new logic.
